full_silhouettes.Aachu: Complete head-to-shoes silhouette; right arm fully readable; left arm present but its hand is naturally obscured by her torso, tote and umbrella.
full_silhouettes.Zuv: Complete head-to-shoes silhouette; right arm fully readable at the lock; left arm routes behind his back and its hand is naturally hidden.

observed_people_arms_hands.anatomy_quality: No duplicated or detached limbs. Aachu's pushing hand has five readable digits and a plausible wrist. Zuv's operating wrist and grip are plausible, but the active limb is anatomically his right arm.

visible_hand_inventory.action: Open palm planted separately against the wooden panel with a braced shoulder and clear push marks.
Spare hand obscured beside the torso, tote and umbrella.
Owns the exterior lever/lock area with a wrapped operating grip.
Spare arm is routed behind his back.

topology.assessment: The push-pull staging is readable and cleanly separated, but it reverses Zuv's required hand assignment: his anatomical right hand operates the lever while his left hand is hidden.

aachu_face.assessment: Recognizable general Aachu lane through long dark hair, complexion and soft profile, but the rendered face is narrower and more pointed than the references, with a sharper nose and reduced eye and cheek specificity. Hair is substantially more wavy and tousled than the straighter, center-parted reference hair.
aachu_face.body: Slim full-body silhouette is plausible, though slightly more elongated and narrow than the reference.

zuv_face.assessment: Broad face, dark hair and beard read as Zuv-adjacent, but the face is narrower, the beard lighter and less full, and the hair is rendered as tight curls rather than the dense swept-up wavy texture in the references.
zuv_face.body: Broad-shouldered, heavier silhouette is directionally consistent with the reference.

height.assessment: Zuv reads visibly taller and broader than Aachu despite his downward lean; the relative scale is consistent with the couple reference.

wardrobe.assessment: Core together-01 wardrobe is preserved: Aachu wears a white shirt, blue jeans and red pointed shoes; Zuv wears a pale-blue embroidered shirt, voluminous gray trousers and red-black shoes. Aachu's reference red handbag is replaced by a beige heart tote, and Zuv's chest embroidery is only an approximate rendering.

verdict: FAIL: the required contact topology is not satisfied because Zuv's anatomical right hand, not his left, operates the exterior lever. Identity fidelity is also only partial for both faces and hair.
repair_decision: REGENERATE_WITH_TARGETED_POSE_AND_IDENTITY_REPAIR: mirror only Zuv's arm assignment so his anatomical left hand visibly wraps and depresses the exterior lever while his right hand is naturally hidden; preserve Aachu's separate anatomical-right weighted palm push and the zero-touch gap. Strengthen Aachu's reference facial proportions and straighter center-parted hair, and restore Zuv's broader face, fuller beard and swept-up wavy hair.
